name: Terraform
description: Lists Terraform workspaces, produces a plan somebody can read, and runs one that has been approved through the guarded change workflow.

config.label: API address
config.hint: Terraform Cloud, or the address of a Terraform Enterprise installation.

config.label: Terraform organization
config.hint: The organization whose workspaces this installation may see. Not this platform's own organization.

config.label: Verify the certificate
config.hint: Turn this off only for a private installation using its own certificate on a network you control.

config.label: Timeout (seconds)
config.hint: A plan takes longer than a read. This is the wait for one HTTP call, not for a run to finish.
